name: patient_has_finding_of_term_infant_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a term neonate (term infant).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a term neonate (term infant).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not a term neonate (term infant).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently a term neonate (term infant).

name: patient_gestational_age_value_recorded_now_withunit_weeks
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's gestational age in weeks, recorded now.
when_unknown: Set to null if no gestational age in weeks is recorded now or the value is indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the measured gestational age in weeks if a value is recorded now.
